title: Show HN: Voice driven murder mystery, Interview AI suspects with your voice
summary: A voice-driven murder mystery game where players interview AI-powered suspects using OpenAI's GPT-Realtime-2.1 model via WebRTC for real-time speech-to-speech conversations. The developer revisited and improved a proof-of-concept built 2-3 years ago with today's more advanced voice AI technology.
problem_solved: Enables natural voice-based interactive storytelling where players can interrogate AI characters in a murder mystery game setting
why_valuable: Demonstrates practical application of cutting-edge voice AI for immersive entertainment experiences, making AI characters feel more lifelike through conversational dialogue
